body_lead: HYDERABAD: The Human Rights Forum (HRF) has urged that the state government suspend existing commitments and refrain from making fresh ones for hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data centres until independent assessments establish that their water and energy requirements will not compromise drinking water supplies, agriculture and ecological needs. In a statement, HRF questioned the government’s push for large-scale AI infrastructure at a time when Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has warned of water scarcity and urged farmers to defer a crop cycle to conserve water for drinking purposes.
